title: TPOT Music Pack
description: A resource pack that replaces some of the Minecraft music with soundtrack from the popular object show TPOT (The Power of Two)
body:
WARNING!! THIS RESOURCE PACK IS STILL HEAVILY W.I.P! CURRENT VERSION: v0.1

Resource Pack that replaces some of the vanilla Minecraft Songs with the original soundtrack from the popular object show TPOT (The Power of Two)

The list of current changed soundtracks:
- Boss (C418) -> Powers Collide! (Ian Woodside)
- Deeper (Lena Raine) -> The Storm (Ian Woodside)
- Echo in the Wind (Aaron Cherof) -> What's The Deal With Waterfalls (Ian Woodside)
- Floating Dream (Kumi Tanioka) -> An Empty Clubhouse (Ian Woodside)
